_comment: Values are starting points, not measurements of a real camera. Invariants (subject CoC, anchor blur, shake px) override presets; see studio/blender_ops/look_camera.py.

invariants._subject_max_coc_px: Focus subject's bbox near/far points must stay within this circle-of-confusion at output res; f-stop is raised until true (max f/22).
invariants._anchor_max_blur_px: Label anchor points may not smear more than this per exposure; shutter is lowered until true. DDP test: shutter 0.25 smeared foreground.
invariants._scene_target_blur_px: p95 screen speed * shutter aims at this; real 180-degree shutter look without smearing details.
invariants._shake_max_rms_px: Rotation shake is scaled down so RMS image jitter stays under this (telephoto magnifies angular shake).

subtle._lens: Blender 5.2.2 Lens Distortion: positive = barrel (verified on a grid), negative = pincushion. Fit is enabled for barrel; it rescales the frame.

compositor._subtle_nograin: Official preset (look_camera.compositor_setup). Grain is not implemented: the grain tests were dropped. On shots with 3D-anchored labels the lens op is removed (allow-list POSITION_PRESERVING).
